description: Inference Endpoint Variant on a Single Instance
rationale: A production variant backed by one instance is served from one Availability Zone, so the loss of that zone, the instance, or a routine host replacement takes the variant offline; the same single instance also absorbs every deployment and every scaling event as an interruption. SageMaker spreads two or more instances of a variant across Availability Zones on its own, which is the whole difference between an endpoint that survives a zone failure and one that does not - and an inference endpoint is usually a synchronous dependency of something a user is waiting on.
remediation: Raise the initial instance count of the variant to at least two in a new endpoint configuration and update the endpoint to it, or move the variant to serverless inference, where SageMaker provides the capacity
